products.description:

Designed for those who want to travel further and tackle a variety of outdoor terrain, the S700 combines powerful performance, advanced suspension and luxurious seating to make every journey more enjoyable.

Exceptional Outdoor Performance

The Sterling S700 features an advanced all-round independent suspension system, with individual suspension on every wheel. This helps absorb bumps and uneven surfaces, delivering a smoother, more comfortable ride whether you’re travelling around town or exploring more varied terrain.

products.name: Refurbished Alpha 8 Mobility Scooter
products.short_description: The refurbished Alpha 8 mobility scooter is a powerful yet compact road scooter offering comfort, long range, and confidence on every journey. With large 12” tyres, a heavy-duty battery, and a comfortable captain’s seat, it’s perfect for everyday use and longer adventures alike.
products.description:
The refurbished Alpha 8 mobility scooter offers the perfect balance between performance and practicality. Designed as a compact, narrower road scooter, it’s easy to manoeuvre in busy areas while still delivering the power and stability you need for longer journeys.

Thanks to its large 12” tyres and excellent ground clearance, this scooter is ideal for days out with family, whether you’re heading to the high street, the countryside, or even the seaside. In addition, the heavy-duty battery provides an impressive range of up to 25 miles per charge, giving you the freedom to travel further with confidence.

Despite being a road scooter, the Alpha 8’s narrow width means doorways, shops, and crowded pavements are no problem at all. However, when you want to venture off the beaten path, the powerful motor handles hills and uneven ground with ease.

Comfort is a priority too. The generous captain’s chair, unique suspension system, and adjustable armrests ensure a smooth and supportive ride wherever you’re going. For simple, user-friendly control, the delta handlebar makes steering effortless, while the easy-to-use controls sit right at your fingertips. There’s also a handy front basket for carrying shopping or personal items.

 Overall, the refurbished Alpha 8 mobility scooter delivers outstanding comfort, range, and value in one reliable package.
